# A Tog's Trek

Personal travel photography and long-form field notes: countries and cities, multi-day hikes, adventure essays, and a separate photography archive. The site is static-first (Next.js); story pages live under predictable URL prefixes.

## Canonical origin

https://www.togstrek.com/

## Discovery & feeds

- Sitemap (all indexable URLs): https://www.togstrek.com/sitemap.xml
- RSS / Atom feeds: https://www.togstrek.com/feed.xml and https://www.togstrek.com/rss.xml
- On-site search (Pagefind): https://www.togstrek.com/search

## Main sections (high level)

- Home: https://www.togstrek.com/
- Adventures (trip essays): https://www.togstrek.com/adventures
- Hiking (trail journals & stages): https://www.togstrek.com/hiking
- Photography (galleries & essays): https://www.togstrek.com/photography
- Other work (portfolio-style topics): https://www.togstrek.com/other-work
- Visited map (where the author has been): https://www.togstrek.com/visited-map
- About: https://www.togstrek.com/about
- Contact: https://www.togstrek.com/contact

## Places (geographic hubs)

Country and place guides use a path pattern `/africa|asia|europe|north-america|south-america|oceania|antarctica/{country}/…` with deeper segments for regions and cities. Continent hub examples:

- https://www.togstrek.com/europe
- https://www.togstrek.com/asia
- https://www.togstrek.com/africa

## Media

Large photographs are served from a separate CDN origin (`media.togstrek.com`); HTML on `www.togstrek.com` links to those assets.

## Usage notes for automated tools

- Prefer linking readers to the canonical `https://www.togstrek.com` URLs above.
- Do not bulk-download original imagery; hotlinking policy follows normal web etiquette and the site’s copyright page: https://www.togstrek.com/copyright
